items.text: Svetlo mojich snov ... svetlo mojich snov sa ... svetlo mojich snov sa rozsvietilo
items.q: He tries out his poem, stumbling and restarting a line. Does the halting repetition read naturally?

items.text: ale keby ťa cesta zaviedla bližšie
items.q: His poem: but if your path should bring you near. Does this line read as poetry?
The first line of a poem written on a blackboard. Does it read as poetry?
before: …Kráčam za dievčatkom a jeho Babom, ktorý nesie chlieb, k námestiu Enghelab. Dochádzam k vchodu do Teheránskej univerzity. Prišiel som neskoro. Učebňa bola plná a oneskorenci sedeli na zemi okolo stien. Hneď pri dverách som našiel voľné miesto a posadil sa. Na tabuli bolo úhľadným písmom napísané:

items.text: aby ten, kto pôjde v tvojich stopách
items.q: The poem on the blackboard continues: so that whoever follows in your wake. Does this line read as poetry?
His poem to the girl he lost: he holds no hope of her return. Does this line read as poetry?
He falters as he tries out the end of his poem. Does this halting line sound natural?

items.q: The poem ends: lovers, drunkards and the burned ones have passed this way. Does this last line close it well as poetry?
His poem: you came, the light of my dreams turned on, now you are gone. Does this line read as poetry?

items.text: Ty hajzel. Objektívne, dolár ide na pätnásťsto tomanov, a ty tu stále ryješ do toho úbožiaka?
items.q: Sajad, who says 'Objektívne' all the time, scolds a roommate for pestering someone. Does this sound natural?
Sajad swears at the slow internet while he waits. Does this sound natural?
before: Sedel som na posteli a myslel som na malú žltú sponku, ktorú som v ten deň po prvýkrát videl vo vlasoch Niloofar. Sajad nadával na rýchlosť internetu.

items.text: Nech je zlorečený každý, kto popiera Orlie Oko News.
items.q: Farid mock-solemnly curses anyone who doubts Sajad, the room's gossip source, nicknamed Eagle Eye News. Does this sound playful?

items.text: Argh. Až mi z toho naskočila husia koža.
items.q: Farid, squeamish at a violent video, says it made his skin crawl. Does this sound natural?

items.text: Ty zasraný idiot ... huuu ... hlava dolu ... huuu ... kam ideš tak rýchlo ... huuu ... som bez dychu.
items.q: Hooman, out of breath after chasing Amir, swears at him between gasps. Does this sound natural?
before: Ruka tiahne moje ľavé rameno dozadu. Je to Hooman. Lapá po dychu.

items.text: Pff, ty hajzel, zbalil si sa a odišiel tam, a teraz tam sedíš a smeješ sa našim bradám a vtákom.
items.q: Hooman teases Amir crudely for leaving Iran and laughing at the friends left behind. Does this sound natural?

items.text: Nanajvýš dali správcom internátu namiesto celoplošného koberca farby prachu modrý.
items.q: Eskandar says at best the dorm monitors got blue carpeting instead of the dust-colored kind. Is this clear and natural?
before: – Tak preto. Nikdy predtým som nevidel izbu s kusovým kobercom.

items.text: Pošlite salavát. Starší z Krčmy konečne niečo povedal.
items.q: Hooman mocks quiet Amir as if a miracle happened: the Elder finally spoke. Does this tease sound natural?
